name: Love Sweet Harem
source:
I received two separate love confessions from two girls.

Ohhhh, who should I choose? It would be nice if I could date them both at once...

That was just a fantasy, I thought, but both girls agreed!

So we all three became lovers. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084225.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我收到了两个女孩分别的告白。啊——该选谁呢？如果能同时和两个人交往就好了……我以为那只是幻想，但两个女孩都同意了！于是我们三个人成了恋人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084225.html]DLsite English[/url]]
